path_convention: Historical source paths below identify the original workspace; the verified final checkpoint is bundled at checkpoints/massachusetts.pt.

result_source.normalization: All numerical metrics and protocol values were preserved. The original hosted checkpoint path was replaced with repository-relative provenance; dataset, model and record status were added.

checkpoint.metadata_verification: Inspected primitive metadata in the checkpoint ZIP data.pkl using pickletools without executing pickle or loading tensors; epoch and cfg agree with the result and archived YAML.
checkpoint.selection: Maximum recorded pooled validation F1 at threshold 0.5 on deterministic 512-by-512 center crops; validation every 10 epochs. Historical history.json contains epochs 1 through 250 and its best recorded F1 is at epoch 240.

split.name: WeavingUnet Massachusetts subset
split.construction: Pair sorted training/images paths with matching masks, shuffle with random.Random(42), use the first round(0.1*N) pairs for validation and the remainder for training. Test pairs come from the separate eval directory.
split.scope_note: This is the repository's 778-image Massachusetts subset. Do not describe these counts as the complete original Massachusetts benchmark split.
split.verification: Historical evaluator reports 60 validation and 178 test images; the local source dataset contains 600 training images and 178 eval images. Individual historical file identities and dataset bytes were not recorded in the result JSON.
